placers.name: Alyssa Beasley
placers.note: No class year, so no profile under the current-classes rule. She is the single unresolved placer key in Arkansas: 1,040 of 1,042 resolved (99.8%), and the other unresolved key is a 'Forfeit' pseudo-participant slot in the 2024 boys 5A 165 bracket, which is not a wrestler at all. Her two prints disagree and cannot both be right - 'HS Junior' in 2024 implies 2025, 'HS Senior' in 2026 implies 2026 - and RankWrestlers holds no record for her under any search variant, so there is nothing to break the tie. Muse held the conflict unforced and so do we; forcing it would hand a real wrestler a class year we invented. Her best finish is 4th, so no Arkansas champion or finalist is affected. A profile follows the moment a year surfaces or her family claims her. She was minted by the 3 Nov pass, which creates profiles with no class year by default, and removed again the same hour (3 Nov 2026).
